messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 17 January
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 17 January to 02:00 Sunday 18 January for scheduled maintenance. Please ensure documents are checked in before 21:00. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
